note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

precepts.why: “There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.” It seems right to go do it, but it ends in death. We cannot play with God or this Bible. We can't use good intents to do evil works or cover foolishness. We have to learn to follow orders in this truth and follow what the Most High set before us.

moments.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: “heard of the valiant acts and warlike deeds which they had done.” Joseph and Azarias heard what Judas and Jonathan were doing. “Let us also get us a name”. Let us be like them and get a name. “and go fight against the heathen that are round about us.” We're going to fight the heathen and do like Judas was doing.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: “So when they had given charge unto the garrison that was with them”. The garrison was a group of men; they had thousands of men following their foolishness.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: “Joseph and Azaras were put to flight”. Nobody told them to go out and fight. The Lord put the spirit on Judas, Jonathan, and the brothers, not on them to go out there. They wanted to make a name for themselves under the guise of good intentions, just going out to destroy the people. “there were slain that day of the people of Israel about two thousand men.” Two thousand men got slain because they tried to do a mighty deed under the guise of good intentions.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

points: “because they were not obedient unto Judas and his brethren”. They were self-willed. They didn't want to follow the men before them. The same thing happens in this truth: men want to recreate the wheel and make their own blueprint when the blueprint is laid out already. The Lord put the spirit on the men who came before them. Our job is to follow orders, follow the men set before us, and the Lord will bless us.

Trying to make your own name and do your own thing gets people hurt. Two thousand men got put to death. We had good intentions to fight our enemy—but God didn't send you out there. “but thought to do some valiant act.”
